report.summary: Patient P-D011 is 34 with commercial high-deductible coverage and no transportation benefit. Age-based and Medicaid ride programs are not eligible. Identified community transport options focus on ADA paratransit certification and public transit; medical ride-booking service was not pursued because it requested external submission of patient identifiers.

options.how_to_access: Only if the patient enrolls in Medicaid; otherwise not eligible. Members call the number on their card at least 2 business days ahead.

options.how_to_access: Not eligible: requires adults age 60+; patient is 34.
